data.name: Concussive Bomb*
data.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it inflict sonic damage. Concussive bombs deal %1d%2 points of sonic damage instead of the normal damage for a bomb. Creatures that take a direct hit from a concussive bomb are deafened for 1 minute unless they succeed at a Fortitude save.|AlchemistBombAdditionalDice+1|ConcusiveBombDieSize
